title_sq: Okazion! Tek Primo Rezidence, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Ne Ndertim Te Perfunduar !!
description_sq: Okazion! Tek Primo Rezidence, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Ne Ndertim Te Perfunduar !! Apartamenti me siperfaqe totale 99.81 m2, ndodhet ne katin e 3-te banim te nje pallati 10-katesh i sapo perfunduar dhe me punime shume cilesore. Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne dhomen e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, nje dhome gjumi matrimoniale me garderobe, ballkoni dhe tualeti dites. Pallati ne te cilin ndodhet apartamenti dallohet per punimet cilesore, duke filluar nga instalimet hidraulike inkaso, instalimet e sistemit te kondicionimit multisplit, shtrimi me parket ose me pllake, dritare dopioxham termike etj. Ndertimi aktualisht ndodhet ne perfundim te fazes se fasades dhe parashikohet dorezimi i tij deri ne fund te vitit.
title_en: Opportunity! At Primo Rezidence, 2+1 apartment for sale, under construction!!
description_en: Opportunity! At Primo Rezidence, 2+1 apartment for sale, under construction!! The apartment with a total area of ​​99.81 m2 is located on the 3rd residential floor of a 10-story building, recently completed and with very high-quality works. The apartment is organized into a living room with a kitchenette, a double bedroom with a wardrobe, a balcony and a day toilet. The building in which the apartment is located stands out for its quality works, starting from inkaso plumbing installations, multisplit air conditioning system installations, flooring with parquet or tiles, thermal double-glazed windows, etc. The building is currently at the end of the facade phase and it is expected to be delivered by the end of the year.
